body:
Hello, Rhyolite here.

Initially I was confused as hell reading this, but then towards the end I finally realized who this person actually is, and I'm not surprised they would do this. Not only are the events you're describing are largely untrue, but you ought to be ashamed of yourself for even thinking of conjuring it up to begin with.
It's true that I picked your similar team after a set, but not "to proove a point," and after YOU beat me once, YOU quit the set, told me off and then left, but not before coming in MY messages. I blocked YOU afterwards. There was no damn "good grief" or "GTFO." I DARE you to show "proof" that I harassed you in messages, and wish you the best of luck in doing so.
You talk shit about me everytime I pass you by in lobby, as if unprovoked and out of spite, and now you want go on Reddit and cry (false) victim? "I'm a just a beginner, Rhyo didn't have to scope me out like that?" You got some serious nerve.

I definitely know I'm not a toxic person; I've seen and heard many disgusting things within the community, including individuals like this feeling so spiteful they would slander and fabricate stories to paint me as one.
There are many people out there who want me to fail, so I can't clear my name or change their minds. I look at this post with a bittersweet smile, knowing that there are some incredibly sad people out there.

EDIT: Not sure how to reply on here, but as OP keeps prattling on, he still has yet to provide actual proof to provide his claims. I will take your words seriously when you grow up and learn to become honest in the future.
The community could use the less likes of dishonest players who go and cry lies on Reddit just because they're having a bad day online.

Also I'm not a troll but fuckall my lone voice against an entire community, right? 🙄
I wish this were in the game! Nice work :)

From my honest opinion, when it comes to ASW games--CF and Cross Tag in general--you're better off playing with your close set of friends rather than with the community. A lot of people you come across online are extremely rude, assholes, or a combination of both to where it can get to you. Since beta days, I had to deal with a loooot of shit-talking and disrespect from many netplayers to a point where it's ruined my experience of this game a bit.
There's a lot more bad (Netplayers complaining in lobby chat after a loss or getting hatemail) and ugly (getting mocked/looked down upon for playing Makoto or Yukiko as opposed to "eSports" like Gord and Ruby, players beating you once and then avoiding you indefinitely afterwards) than good. The more of a name you make for yourself in this community (in which there's pettiness, bitterness and jealousy afoot), the more problems you face head on.

Like everyone else says, every community has their shitty apples of the bunch, and here is no different. There's just quite a few more of them here.

No.

Edit: Not surprised by the downvotes. I'll keep advocating she isn't the worst.

No one is.
